verdict.rationale: Gemini Notebook generates insights directly from user-uploaded sources: grounded chat with inline citations, auto-generated source summaries, mind maps, briefings and Critique-style feedback. It also offers AI-suggested report types, and community users describe getting useful explanations from their own material. missing for 10: documented proactive or unprompted suggestion surfacing beyond suggested report types, and deeper independent hands-on evaluation of insight quality.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can get AI-generated insights and suggestions from my data inside the product

citations.quote: Get insights in the moment by asking questions about your sources.
Chat with your notebook to get grounded information based on your sources with clear in-line citations for accuracy, transparency, and trust.
Find an auto-generated summary of the entire source in the Source Guide.
Create your own, or choose from FAQ, study guide, briefing document, or an AI suggested report type.
The Critique for critical feedback. Two hosts provide a constructive evaluation of material like an essay or design doc.
Mind Maps in Gemini Notebook visually summarize your uploaded sources, showing main topics and related ideas as a branching diagram.
